snippet.title: The Way of the Exploding Fist Longplay (C64) [QHD]
snippet.description:
Developed by Beam Software and published by Melbourne House in 1985

Fantastic one-on-one fighting game by Beam Software that incorporates great visuals (for the time), audio samples and superb gameplay. The difficulty curve in single-player is spot on, and multiplayer is great fun too!

The game keeps looping after reaching 10th Dan, so I called it quits not long after.

Credits
Coding: Gregg Barnett, David Johnston
Graphics: Greg Holland
Music: Neil Brennan
